name: bench
description: Bench is a local team task board.

scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run start -w @bench/server" "npm run dev -w @bench/client"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @bench/server && npm run test -w @bench/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @bench/server && npm run typecheck -w @bench/client
